name: HERE Maps
tagline: Maps, geocoding, routing, and location services for global applications
description: HERE Location Services provide maps, geocoding, reverse geocoding, routing, traffic, and places APIs used by developers to build location-aware applications. Official docs and self-serve credentials live on the HERE developer platform.

auth.details: API key via query parameter apiKey= (self-serve platform signup); OAuth/JWT also available for enterprise.

use_cases: calculate a driving route between two points
get traffic conditions along a route
